image_description: A night-time outdoor concert scene featuring a band performing on an elevated stage. Three musicians are visible from the back/side: a guitarist on the left in camouflage pants, a central figure in light jeans, and a bassist/guitarist on the right. The stage is illuminated by bright yellow and white overhead lights, creating lens flare and atmospheric haze. In the background, a crowd is visible, along with a lit Ferris wheel against the dark sky. Microphone stands, drum kits, and amplifiers are present on the stage surface.
